title: 第15章 佛像
content_zh:
魏乐府自然是察觉到了孟知节和孟明珠的包抄行为。

    有老弟从天上俯瞰，所有细节魏乐府都看得清清楚楚。

    “你俩别动。”魏乐府慢悠悠地说道：“再动，我就再锤两下。”

    “现在还有机会把这八宝金身拼回去。”

    “这要是再挨两下锤，可就不一定了。”

    听到这话，孟知节和孟明珠两个人不由得身形一顿。

    而后暗中瞧了眼孟惟。

    孟惟见此，也只能无奈地小幅度一点头，随后又打了个手势让这两人退回去。

    “你就此离开，这件事我既往不咎。”孟惟沉声说道。

    魏乐府听到这话，也是一乐。

    这孟惟对于他这个‘丁守成’的心态还没有转过来啊。

    依旧是把自己当成他的三弟子了。

    “好，你们再退十步。”魏乐府说道：“给我留出一条生路。”

    “可以，但是你先把金瓜锤收起来。”孟惟继续说道，他也怕魏乐府狗急跳墙。

    “你先退，我再收。”魏乐府可不惯着对方，直接说道：“不然我一收你就往我身上扔飞镖怎么办？”

    “不可能，要是你...”孟惟自然也不会同意。

    结果他刚开口，话都没说完，魏乐府的金瓜锤就举起来要再砸下去。

    “好好好，我们退，我们退。”孟惟最终还是选择退让，毕竟他们占据优势，就算退十步又能如何？

    三人不甘心地退了十步后，魏乐府果断蹲了下来，提着金瓜锤邦邦邦地猛砸佛像碎片。

    有部分直接成了齑粉，也有部分完全看不清楚了。

    他们就算是拿到了，也无法凑成八宝金身的内容，甚至只有一小部分能看。

    这一幕落在三人眼里，三人也是愣了，而后毫不犹豫地冲了上来。

    三人完全无法理解魏乐府为什么要这么做。

    而魏乐府见此，也是把最后一部分砸了个粉碎使其彻底报废，然后把金瓜锤一扔就跑。

    这两柄金瓜锤可不轻，特别是他身上还穿着厚棉甲，要不然刚才那两柄飞刀扎在他身上怎么可能一点事都没有。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu was naturally aware of Meng Zhijie and Meng Mingzhu's outflanking behavior.

    A brother looked down from the sky, and Wei Yuefu could see all the details clearly.

    "You two, don't move." Wei Yuefu said slowly, "If you move again, I'll hammer you two more times."

    "Now there is still a chance to put this eight-treasure golden body back together."

    "If it gets hammered twice more, it won't necessarily be the case."

    Hearing this, Meng Zhijie and Meng Mingzhu couldn't help but tremble.

    Then he glanced at Meng Wei secretly.

    Seeing this, Meng Wei could only nod helplessly, and then made a gesture to ask the two people to retreat.

    "You just leave, and I will put this matter in the past." Meng Wei said in a deep voice.

    Wei Yuefu was also happy when he heard this.

    Meng Wei hasn't changed his attitude towards this 'Ding Shoucheng' yet.

    He still regards himself as his third disciple.

    "Okay, you guys take ten steps back." Wei Yuefu said, "Leave a way for me to survive."

    "Okay, but you put away the pumpkin hammer first." Meng Wei continued, he was also afraid that Wei Yuefu would jump over the wall in a hurry.

    "You retreat first, and I will accept you later." Wei Yuefu did not tolerate the other party, and said directly: "What if you throw darts at me as soon as I accept you?"

    "Impossible, if you..." Meng Wei naturally would not agree.

    As a result, as soon as he opened his mouth and before he could finish his words, Wei Yuefu's pumpkin hammer was raised to smash it down again.

    "Okay, okay, let's retreat, let's retreat." Meng Wei finally chose to give in. After all, they had the advantage, so what if they took ten steps back?

    After the three of them took ten steps back unwillingly, Wei Yuefu squatted down decisively and smashed the pieces of the Buddha statue with a hammer and hammer.

    Some parts turned into fans directly, and some parts were completely invisible.

    Even if they got it, they couldn't piece together the contents of the Eight Treasures Golden Body, and only a small part could even be read.

    This scene fell in the eyes of the three people, and the three of them were stunned, and then rushed forward without hesitation.

    The three of them couldn't understand why Wei Yuefu did this.

    When Wei Yuefu saw this, he smashed the last part to pieces to make it completely useless, then threw the pumpkin hammer and ran away.

    These two pumpkin hammers are not light, especially when he is wearing thick cotton armor. Otherwise, how could the two flying knives just pierced his body without any harm at all.
